role: DATAML citation validator (independent, did not build bibliography)

inputs.crossref_fetch: live api.crossref.org/works/{doi}, all 726 DOIs, no sampling
inputs.europepmc_fetch: live ebi.ac.uk/europepmc search, 6 entries flagged by actor

verdict: PASS — references.bib is publication-ready. All 726 entries resolve at CrossRef and match their live records on first author, full author list, title, year, journal, volume, issue and pages. Keys are byte-identical to the 726 certified cite keys including all 48 disambiguation suffixes; no duplicates, no contamination, file is pure ASCII, every cite key used in the 10 sections resolves, and there are no orphans. Two non-blocking defects found (HTML entities inherited verbatim from CrossRef in 36 journal names + 1 title; one book chapter typed @misc) and two actor claims found slightly misstated (preprint @misc count; 'all 34 disagreements resolved in favour of the fresh fetch'). No blocking failure.

CROSSREF_RESOLVES.note: 726/726 HTTP 200 on fresh fetch; one DOI (10.1038/s41593-025-01888-4) returned 429 on first attempt and 200 on polite retry. Includes the 7 DOIs on the 10.64898 prefix, which resolve normally.

AUTHOR_CROSSREF_MATCH.note: Bib first-author surname equals CrossRef author[0].family after LaTeX-accent decoding and ASCII folding for 725/726. Sunderland1987 passes via Europe PMC: its CrossRef record carries zero authors (author[] empty), and the bib author list matches Europe PMC exactly.
AUTHOR_CROSSREF_MATCH.full_author_list_check: Also compared the COMPLETE author list of every entry against CrossRef: 726/726 agree in length and order; the only character-level differences are 3 entries where CrossRef itself stores U+FFFD (Cramer1981 'Schr\ufffdter', Freund1990 'Buzs\ufffdki', Molins1991 'Catal\ufffdn') and the bib carries the correct Europe PMC spelling.

TITLE_SIMILARITY.note: After constrained tag-stripping (<i>,<scp>), LaTeX-accent/math decoding and Greek-letter folding, 725/726 titles are token-identical to CrossRef. The single non-identical title is Esclapez1995, where the CrossRef title is corrupt ('decar\u2610ylase', ballot box for 'box'); the bib carries the correct Europe PMC title.

YEAR_MATCH.note: 726/726 exact — not merely within the \u00b11 tolerance.

ASCII_ONLY.note: Zero bytes >127 anywhere in the file, not just in author fields. All diacritics encoded as LaTeX accent commands; $..$ math delimiters balanced in all 726 titles; no unescaped &, %, #, _ ; no residual HTML tags.

KEYS_MATCH_CERTIFIED_MAP.note: Set of 726 bib keys is byte-for-byte identical to the 726 values in citation_key_map.json; 0 extra, 0 missing. Each entry's doi field also equals the map key for that cite key (726/726). 48 keys carry a disambiguation suffix, forming 22 complete groups with contiguous a,b(,c) sequences and no gaps.

KEY_UNIQUE.note: No duplicate cite keys; no duplicate DOIs; no duplicate entries.

KEY_DERIVATION.note: All 726 keys match ^[A-Za-z]+[0-9]{4}[a-z]?$; the surname component equals the ASCII-folded CrossRef author[0].family for 726/726 and the year component equals both the bib year and the CrossRef year for 726/726.

NO_CONTAMINATION.note: For every entry, the bib first-author surname appears in that DOI's own CrossRef author list. No bib title matches a different DOI's CrossRef title better than its own. Zero cross-DOI contamination.

JOURNAL_MATCH.note: All 700 @article journal names equal CrossRef container-title[0] after entity/markup folding. The 26 @misc entries carry no journal field; 25 have an empty CrossRef container-title (posted-content), and Chesselet2007 has container-title 'Novartis Foundation Symposia' (see warnings).

VOLUME_ISSUE_PAGES.note: volume (693 entries) and number/issue (592) match CrossRef exactly; pages (686) match CrossRef page or article-number exactly. The 40 entries with no pages field are exactly the entries for which CrossRef supplies neither page nor article-number — 0 cases of an omitted but available value.

ALL_KEYS_IN_BIB.note: 1441 {cite:p}/{cite:t} key occurrences across the 10 sections resolve to 726 distinct keys; all 726 exist in references.bib. 0 unresolved keys — MyST build is not blocked. No other citation syntax (\\cite{}, pandoc [@key]) appears in any section.

NO_ORPHAN_BIB.note: 0 orphan entries: every one of the 726 bib entries is cited at least once.

warnings.issue: HTML entities inherited verbatim from CrossRef and escaped as literal text: 36 entries contain '\\&' in the journal field (e.g. "Alzheimer's \\& Dementia") and Lisgaras2025 contains '\\>250 Hz' in its title. In LaTeX these render as '&' and '>' rather than '&' and '>'. Chen2024 additionally carries '{\\textregistered}' from CrossRef's '\u00ae'.
warnings.verified: All 37 occurrences are present in the CrossRef source strings themselves — this is faithful transcription, not fabrication. Not blocking; fix is a mechanical entity unescape before typesetting.

warnings.issue: Chesselet2007 (10.1002/9780470514733.ch4) is typed @misc with howpublished={Wiley}, but it is a Novartis Foundation Symposium book chapter (CrossRef type 'other', container-title 'Novartis Foundation Symposia'), not a preprint. As @misc with no journal/booktitle it will render without a venue.

Three works are cited as both preprint and published version under distinct DOIs, correctly disambiguated with a/b suffixes: Consens2022a (bioRxiv) / Consens2022b (Front Mol Neurosci); Morgan2024a (Sci Rep) / Morgan2024b (Research Square); Yokomizo2025a (Adv Sci) / Yokomizo2025b (bioRxiv). Not duplicates — distinct records — but the author may prefer to cite only the version of record.

actor_claim_adjudication.claim: 726 entries = exactly the 726 certified keys, 0 retained-but-uncited, 0 missing
actor_claim_adjudication.evidence: 726 parsed entries; bib key set minus certified key set = {} and certified minus bib = {}; 0 orphans; 0 cited-but-missing.

actor_claim_adjudication.claim: 1,441 citation-key occurrences across the 10 sections resolve to 726 distinct keys
actor_claim_adjudication.evidence: Independently re-extracted from the 10 section artifacts: 1441 occurrences (02:113, 03:124, 04:230, 05:112, 06:139, 07:133, 08:128, 09:188, 10:125, 11:149), 726 distinct, all resolving.

actor_claim_adjudication.claim: All 726 DOIs resolve in a fresh CrossRef fetch
actor_claim_adjudication.evidence: Independent fresh fetch of all 726: 726/726 HTTP 200 (one 429 cleared on a single polite retry).

actor_claim_adjudication.claim: 34 cache-vs-fetch disagreements, all resolved in favour of the fresh fetch (27 journal, 4 type, 1 title en dash, 1 pages, 1 first_author)
actor_claim_adjudication.verdict: PARTIALLY CONFIRMED — count and breakdown exact; the 'all in favour of the fresh fetch' characterisation is wrong for 2 of 34, though the final bib value is correct in both

evidence.count: 34 disagreements, breakdown exactly 27 journal / 4 type / 1 title / 1 pages / 1 first_author — confirmed.
evidence.agreement: For 33/34 the logged fetched value equals the current live CrossRef value, and for 33/34 the bib carries that value.
evidence.exception_1: pages, Wunderlin2026 (10.1038/s41598-026-47886-9): logged fetch = '' (empty), cache = '11716'. The bib carries 11716, which is CrossRef's article-number for this record and is correct — so this one was resolved in favour of the cache / article-number recovery, not the fetch.
evidence.exception_2: first_author, Sunderland1987 (10.1176/ajp.144.10.1313): logged fetch = '' because the CrossRef record has an empty author array. The bib carries 'Sunderland', taken from Europe PMC — resolved in favour of Europe PMC, not the fetch. Resolving in favour of the fetch here would have produced an authorless entry.
evidence.net: Both exceptions produce the correct final value; no action needed, but the claim as worded overstates the rule.

actor_claim_adjudication.claim: 6 entries take fields from Europe PMC because CrossRef is incomplete or carries U+FFFD / ballot-box mojibake: Sunderland1987, Cramer1981, Esclapez1995, Freund1990, Herrmann2001, Molins1991
actor_claim_adjudication.verdict: CONFIRMED — all 6 corrupted at CrossRef, all 6 Europe PMC substitutions correct

evidence.scan: An independent scan of all 726 live CrossRef records for U+FFFD / U+2610 / U+25A1 in author or title returned exactly 5 entries (Cramer1981, Esclapez1995, Freund1990, Herrmann2001, Molins1991), and exactly 1 record has an empty author array (Sunderland1987) — the same 6, no more and no fewer.
evidence.Sunderland1987: CrossRef author[] empty. Europe PMC gives Sunderland, Rubinow, Tariot, Cohen, Newhouse, Mellow (+2); bib matches all 8 in order. Title, Am J Psychiatry 1987, 1313--1316 all match.
evidence.Cramer1981: CrossRef 'Schr\ufffdter' and a mangled title ('chorea?Measurements'); Europe PMC gives 'Schr\u00f6ter' and 'Huntington's chorea-- measurements...'; bib matches Europe PMC (Schr{\\"o}ter), J Neurol 1981, 183--187.
evidence.Esclapez1995: CrossRef title reads 'decar\u2610ylase' (ballot box); Europe PMC has 'decarboxylase'; bib matches Europe PMC. Authors Esclapez, Houser agree in both. Neuroscience 1995, 339--355.
evidence.Freund1990: CrossRef 'Buzs\ufffdki'; Europe PMC 'Buzs\u00e1ki'; bib has Buzs{\\'a}ki. Authors and title match Europe PMC.
evidence.Herrmann2001: CrossRef title 'Human EEG responses to 1?100\ufffdHz flicker...'; Europe PMC '1-100 Hz'; bib matches Europe PMC. Exp Brain Res 2001, 346--353.
evidence.Molins1991: CrossRef 'Catal\ufffdn'; Europe PMC 'Catal\u00e1n'; bib has Catal{\\'a}n. All 6 authors, title, J Neurol 1991, 168--170 match Europe PMC.
evidence.wrong_author_risk: Specifically checked: none of the 6 carries an author name that is absent from its own Europe PMC record, and none matches another DOI's record. No wrong-author substitution.

actor_claim_adjudication.verdict: PARTIALLY CONFIRMED — 26 @misc entries, but only 25 are preprints
actor_claim_adjudication.evidence: howpublished counts: bioRxiv preprint 19, Research Square preprint 5, medRxiv preprint 1 = 25 preprints (all 25 are CrossRef type 'posted-content', and each entry's server attribution agrees with the CrossRef institution/publisher field). The 26th @misc is Chesselet2007, a Novartis Foundation Symposium book chapter (CrossRef type 'other'), howpublished={Wiley} — not a preprint. See warning W2.

Exactly 182 CrossRef records supply no 'page' but do supply an 'article-number', and in all 182 the bib pages field equals that article-number byte-for-byte. Total non-range pages values in the bib is 278; the remaining 96 are single-page or e-locator values that CrossRef returns in its own 'page' field.

method_notes: Independent re-derivation: the bibliography, key map and section files were re-parsed from the artifacts; no actor-supplied intermediate was trusted.
All 726 CrossRef records fetched live (stdlib urllib, unverified SSL context, 4 workers with inter-request pacing, one retry on 429). 6 Europe PMC records fetched live with 1 s spacing.

Comparison normalisation: constrained HTML tag removal, LaTeX accent-command decoding (\\'a, \\"o, \\k{a}, ...), ligature folding (ss, o, i, l, ae), Greek-letter and $\\alpha$/$\\beta$/$\\times$ folding, en/em-dash folding, case folding, punctuation to whitespace. Jaccard on token sets for titles.
No sampling anywhere: every check ran over all 726 entries and all 10 sections.
